name: Exp_ColorXDerivative
summary: This EA trades based on the ColorXDerivative indicator, which is a colored momentum/derivative oscillator that visualizes the rate of change of price. It generates buy signals when the derivative turns positive (bullish color) and sell signals when the derivative turns negative (bearish color), executing trades with configurable lot sizes and stop levels.
summary_zh: 该EA基于ColorXDerivative指标进行交易，该指标是一个带颜色的动量/导数振荡器，可视化价格的变变化率。当导数转为正值（看涨颜色）时产生买入信号，当导数转为负值（看跌颜色）时产生卖出信号，使用可配置的手数和止损水平执行交易。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于价格导数（即价格变化率）的方向变化来捕捉动量转换点。入场条件是当ColorXDerivative指标从负值转为正值时开多仓，从正值转为负值时开空仓，本质上是捕捉动量方向的反转。出场条件依赖反向信号触发平仓或达到预设的止损/止盈水平，但没有看到明确的追踪止损机制。仓位管理采用固定手数方式，交易者通过参数设定每笔交易的手数，没有根据账户余额动态调整的机制。资金管理方面，EA提供了止损和止盈参数来控制单笔风险，但缺乏整体风险控制如最大回撤限制或每日亏损限制。该策略属于典型的动量反转类系统，适合趋势启动初期入场，但在震荡行情中容易产生频繁的虚假信号。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the directional change of the price derivative (rate of change) to capture momentum shift points. Entry conditions trigger a long position when the ColorXDerivative indicator turns from negative to positive (bullish color change) and a short position when it turns from positive to negative (bearish color change), essentially capturing momentum reversals. Exit conditions rely on opposing signals to close positions or reaching preset stop-loss/take-profit levels, but there is no explicit trailing stop mechanism. Position sizing uses a fixed lot approach where the trader sets the lot size via parameter, without dynamic adjustment based on account balance. Money management provides stop-loss and take-profit parameters to control per-trade risk, but lacks overall risk controls such as maximum drawdown limits or daily loss limits. This strategy is a typical momentum reversal system, suitable for entering at the early stage of trend initiation, but prone to frequent false signals in ranging markets.

parameters.name: StopLoss
parameters.description: 止损点数，0表示不设止损
parameters.description_en: Stop loss in points, 0 means no stop loss

parameters.name: TakeProfit
parameters.description: 止盈点数，0表示不设止盈
parameters.description_en: Take profit in points, 0 means no take profit

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description: EA的魔术编号，用于标识本EA的订单

parameters.name: Timeframe
parameters.description: 指标计算使用的时间周期，0为当前图表周期

pros: 基于动量导数的变化，能较灵敏地捕捉趋势启动点
指标带有颜色可视化，信号判断直观清晰
参数结构简单，易于理解和调优
pros_en: Based on momentum derivative changes, it can sensitively capture trend initiation points
Indicator features color visualization making signal judgment intuitive and clear
Simple parameter structure, easy to understand and optimize
cons: 在震荡行情中容易产生频繁虚假信号导致连续亏损
缺少动态仓位管理，固定手数无法适应不同市场波动
止损默认为0，若未手动设置则风险敞口无限大
cons_en: Prone to frequent false signals in ranging markets leading to consecutive losses
Lacks dynamic position sizing, fixed lots cannot adapt to different market volatility
Stop-loss defaults to 0, leaving unlimited risk exposure if not manually set
improvements: 增加震荡行情过滤器，如ADX或波动率阈值，减少盘整期的虚假信号
实现基于ATR的动态止损和仓位管理，使风险随市场波动自适应
improvements_en: Add a ranging market filter such as ADX or volatility threshold to reduce false signals during consolidation
Implement ATR-based dynamic stop-loss and position sizing for self-adaptive risk management

risk_points: 止损默认值为0，未设置时单笔风险无上限
缺少最大持仓数和每日亏损限制等整体风控机制
动量反转策略在震荡市中可能频繁进出场产生滑点和手续费损耗
risk_points_en: Stop-loss defaults to 0, creating unlimited per-trade risk when not set
Lacks overall risk controls like maximum position count or daily loss limits
Momentum reversal strategy may frequently enter and exit in ranging markets, accumulating slippage and commission costs
